description: Look up public LinkedIn profiles by URL or username and read every section LinkedIn serves to logged-out visitors, plus the current employer's own company page.

enrichCompany.description: Also read the current employer's own public LinkedIn page for employee count, size range, industry, headquarters, address, founded year, followers, website, logo, description, tagline, type and specialties. Uses the free public access path; one request per unique company per run.
enrichCompany.title: Enrich Current Company

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of recent public posts to include per profile. Set 0 to skip posts. Posts come from the same profile page, so this adds no extra requests.
maxPosts.title: Recent Posts per Profile

profileUrls.description: Public LinkedIn profile URLs (https://www.linkedin.com/in/username) or bare usernames. Full URLs, 'in/username' shorthand, regional subdomains and URLs with tracking parameters are all accepted.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs or Usernames

title: LinkedIn Profile Scraper with Company & Credential Data Input
